name: Multi-Sensory Cognitive Anchor Matrix
diagnostic: Does the brand rely exclusively on visual marks, or does it activate sonic, haptic, and spatial cues across its touchpoints?
artifact: Sonic assets: chimes, UI interaction sounds.
Haptic assets: physical substrates, vibration feedback.
Spatial assets: interface hierarchy, environmental layouts.
trap: Introducing shrill or intrusive notification sounds that annoy users, driving them to mute or disable interface audio.
pedigreeFull: Cross-modal sensory branding theory (Charles Spence & Martin Lindstrom, *Brand Sense*, 2005).
artifactFull:
A 5-Sense Cognitive Association Matrix defining:  
  - Visual assets (marks, palettes, typography)  
  - Sonic assets (chimes, UI interaction sounds)  
  - Haptic assets (physical substrates, vibration feedback)  
  - Spatial assets (interface hierarchy, environmental layouts).
trapFull: Introducing shrill or intrusive notification sounds that annoy users, driving them to mute or disable interface audio.
sourceNote: The source calls this a 5-Sense matrix and lists four asset categories; the card prints the four listed and invents no fifth sense.
